name: Milkwort Knotweed
desc: Milkwort Knotweed (Polygonum polygaloides): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 20 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Polygonum polygaloides is a North American species of flowering plants in the buckwheat family known by the common names milkwort knotweed and polygala knotweed.
